Description:
Ballistics of the 8 inch self propelled howitzer M110A2 mounting the gun M201A1. 

Shot travel is 6934mm, chamber volume is 31.84 Liters, length is 1082 mm. The tube is specified for Upper Pressure Limit of 290.2 MPa (70 degrees Farenheit), Permissible Individual Maximum Pressure (do not exceed > 13/10,000) of 330.9 MPa, with the following EFC tables:

M201/M201A1 w/M110A2: 7,500 EFC for tube
Zone 9:  1.0
Zone 7-8 0.7
Zone 1-6 0.25
